title: analysis.code.facts request
description: Compose every code analysis into one fact list, with the instructions it is about. Writes nothing. `read_only`.

region.description: Where the code lives. A boot block and a raw project image are not hunks, and the same question is asked of all three — one selector rather than separate fact models.

hunk.description: CODE hunk to analyze. Omit for `boot_block` and `raw`, which have no hunks.

expected_sha256.description: Required for raw code: the exact digest the source must have before any instruction is decoded.

entries.description: Where the traversal starts, as offsets within the selected code region. Defaults to offset 0. Every fact is about code some entry reaches, so an entry list that misses a routine produces no facts about it rather than wrong ones.

origin.description: The address the hunk is mapped at. Nothing in a LoadSeg image says where it was loaded, so this is the caller's claim about the machine: absolute references cannot be identified without one, and are left unresolved rather than guessed at.

base_register.description: Address register the small-data convention uses. A5 by convention, and the convention is what makes a displacement from it a global rather than an arbitrary offset from an arbitrary pointer.

default_library.description: The library initially in A6. Defaults to `exec` for a boot block, which the machine guarantees — the fact model is told rather than left to infer it from code that never opens exec.

library_vectors.description: Extra vectors, consulted before this build's curated tables. The tables travel as data, never as a path: a frontend reads its own fd files and puts the entries here, so two adapters given the same table get the same facts.

arguments.description: The register each argument arrives in, and the parameter name the table gives it. Both, because a table naming `parm` in `d0` and one saying only `d0` describe different amounts of knowledge.

public.description: Whether the supplying table marked the vector public. False keeps an fd-supplied private name from reading like documented API.
